name: Normal Case: Food Wastage in Canteens
description: Standard hackathon scenario with a specific problem and beginner/intermediate team.

input.problem_statement: Reducing food wastage in college canteens through demand prediction and surplus food redistribution.
input.team_context: 4 people, beginner Python + HTML/CSS skills, 90 minutes remaining

expected_checks: problem_summary is present and clear
user_personas has at least 2 personas (e.g. Canteen Manager, Student)
feature_suggestions has at least 3 features with effort levels
tech_stack_options includes lightweight options (e.g. Flask, HTML/JS)
decision, reason, and next_action are all present

name: Alternate Case: Smart Campus Parking System
description: Domain specific problem with intermediate/advanced tech stack expectations.

input.problem_statement: Real-time smart campus parking space tracking and reservation system to reduce morning congestion.
input.team_context: 3 people, intermediate IoT & Python ML skills, 90 minutes remaining

expected_checks: problem_summary captures real-time tracking requirement
user_personas includes Student Driver & Campus Security
feature_suggestions highlights low-effort MVP features like mock sensors/API
tech_stack_options incorporates Python/OpenCV or lightweight IoT simulation
prototype_priorities focuses on core allocation algorithm

name: Edge Case: Extremely Vague Input
description: Very short or vague problem statement requiring scope narrowing and clarifying questions.

input.team_context: 2 people, beginner frontend developers, 60 minutes remaining

expected_checks: key_questions actively prompts for scope narrowing
design_thinking_guidance focuses on narrowing user segment
feature_suggestions keeps scope tiny (P0 MVP)
decision advises selecting 1 micro-problem immediately

name: Alternate Case: Student Mental Health Tracker
description: Sensitive topic requiring empathetic design thinking and strict privacy guardrails.

input.problem_statement: A confidential AI-based mood tracking and peer support network for university students managing stress.
input.team_context: 4 people, React + Node.js skills, 90 minutes remaining

expected_checks: user_personas emphasizes privacy & trust needs
validation_checkpoints includes privacy/ethics check
demo_prep_tips focuses on storytelling & user journey
next_action provides clear immediate prototype step

name: Edge Case: Highly Complex Technical Scope
description: Overly ambitious project for a 90-min hackathon needing severe scope reduction.

input.problem_statement: Autonomous multi-city traffic optimization using deep reinforcement learning and live satellite imagery streams.

expected_checks: decision strongly recommends simplifying to 1 intersection simulation
prototype_priorities cuts out satellite stream and deep RL for mock dataset
feature_suggestions lists high effort warnings for complex components
